item.description:
## Tuna Season is August - October

**Additional Angler:** $150.00 
   Up to 2 Additional Angers
 
## Trip Duration:
Maximum of Twelve (12) Hours
6:30 AM - 6:30 PM
___________________________________
 
## Charter Details:
- Target Species: Bluefin Tuna, Yellowfin Tuna, Dorado, Marlin
- California And Mexican Fishing License's Not Included

SWELL CHASER

Swell Chaser is a United States Coast Guard Inspected Vessel. Which simply means we have the latest life saving devices and the many other required items that make our customers and crew safe while being out on the ocean. Make sure the charter boat you choose is.

Swell Chaser is built for comfort and safety. The cabin has a very comfortable sofa and extra chairs to relax when going to the fishing grounds. Captain Chris ensures that every amenity is available to you, including a private restroom (also called the “head”). 

Swell Chaser stocked galley with water, energy bars and candy.  When you step on board Swell Chaser, how comfortable she truly is.

Swell Chaser also was made to catch fish and lots of them. Swell Chaser spacious fishing area provides the room for EVERYONE to hook up at the same time. Swell Chaser also has a “five-scoop” live bait system and an amazing fish hold to keep your fillets in excellent condition. Along with Swell Chaser selectronics package and top-of-the-line Avet, Daiwa and Okuma tackle, Chris has everything you need to catch the fish of a lifetime.

WANU

Wanu is a Custom 32’ Marshall flybridge sportfisher powered by a 250 HP Cummins Turbo Diesel with the latest in digital controls. Wanu was specifically designed and built to fish the coastal waters of Southern California. 

This boat is the perfect choice for our 1/2 and 3/4 day coastal trips and if the tuna are close to home the Wanu is the excellent choice for offshore fishing. 

She also has the range to take you as far out as you want…and then some (400 nautical mile range). Wanu is built for comfort and safety. She has a very comfortable cabin to get out of the sun and enjoy your lunch or snack and Captain Chris ensures that every amenity is available to you, including a private restroom (also called the “head”).

 When you step on board Wanu, her fit and finish demonstrates just how “custom” she really is.  Wanu also has a “five-scoop” live bait system to carry that extra bait when needed.

___________________________________
## What to Bring:
- Sun Protection: Sunscreen, Hats, Polarized Glasses
- Rain Protection: Rain Jackets, Foul Weather Gear - “just in case”
- Favorite Food, Drinks, Ice and Cooler for your Catch
- NOTE: Please leave the Cooler and Ice in car
- Also each angler in your party will need to purchase a fishing license from the California Department of Fish and Wildlife. You can follow the link to purchase your fishing license in the confirmation email.
item.booking_notes:
##Thank you for booking with Coletta Sportfishing! 

We look forward to having your party out for Private Fishing Charter!

**NOTE-**
All Anglers need a One day California Fishing License as well as a One Day Mexican Fishing License.  
 
**You can purchase both One Day license's online at California** -www.wildlife.ca.gov/Licensing/Online-Sales  Once the CFG website loads please hit the Blue ONLINE SALES AND SERVICE icon then at the top of the next page please hit the light Green icon Add Customer and follow directions. You do not need an Ocean Enhancement endorsement with a 1 or 2 day Ocean fishing license just a copy of your California one day license and Mexican www.sportfishingbcs.gob.mx  ** Dana Landing Market has great sandwiches that you can buy and everything else that you need including beer, wine, ice etc.  If you purchase beer please purchase cans not bottles. Dana Landing Market opens at 6:00am to 8:00pm daily.
 
**Captain Chris takes your safety seriously and reserves the right to reschedule booked trips due to unsafe weather conditions, mechanical problems and or illness at any time prior trip departure. If a Trip is rescheduled Captain Chris is not responsible for monies lost related to the cost of airfare, lodging or transportation costs and any other costs related to getting to San Diego to fish with Coletta Sport Fishing. The customer is  entitled to a REFUND if the trip is canceled because of bad weather or mechanical problems that were unforeseen . If the customer wants to return early for ANY REASON, customer will not be entitled to any REFUND of monies paid for said charter and the charter is canceled.**

Additional Passengers: If you bring onboard more passengers then you originally paid for the additional charge for said passengers will be added using the credit card on file the day of the trip

Children over the age of 2 are considered a passenger and will be added to the group totally and charged accordingly.
 
If any personal items are left on the boat we are not responsible for lost or forgotten items.

##Where To Meet To Go On Your Fishing Trip:
[Dana Landing Market and Fuel Dock
2580 Ingraham Street
San Diego, CA 92109](https://goo.gl/maps/pMS6EsmSLxv)
**Please make sure that you do not park in the lot in front of the shop. Please either park on the street or park in the Marina lot.**

Don't Forget To Bring:

- Sun Protection, Sunscreen, hats, polarized sunglasses
- Favorite Food, Drinks, Ice and Cooler For Your Catch
 NOTE: Please leave the Cooler and Ice in car
 
Feel free to give Captain Chris a call with any questions (858) 922 – 4328.
item.cancellation_notes:
***Cancellations: Cancellations MUST be requested no less than fifteen (15) days prior to date of trip in order to be eligible to receive a full refund of your deposit. Cancellations requested less than fifteen (15) days prior to date of trip will not be eligible for refund but you can contact Captain Chris about applying deposit to a future trip or gift certificate

***Gift certificates are non refundable and can be applied or used towards any trip for up to a year from purchase date

***Canceling or wanting to Reschedule a trip with in 24 HOURS of your Scheduled Departure Time:  You will be charged the full amount of your trip scheduled if you cancel or try to reschedule a trip with in 24 hours prior the trip scheduled departure time. You will not be entitled to a refund or be able to reschedule said trip. If the customer wants to reschedule another trip at that time they will be charged the full amount of the charter of their choosing

***Rescheduling of Trips: If a customer wants to reschedule their booked trip within the 15 days of their scheduled trip a $250.00 Rescheduling Fee will be charged to the customer

***Rescheduled trips are good for one year starting from the original scheduled trip date

***Any "Rescheduled" trip (2nd time) that is canceled is not entitled to a refund of any kind and will be given a 6 month grace period from the Second cancelation date to reschedule
